case_reviews.question: On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.
case_reviews.evidence: date of birth refers to drivers.dob; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa; first qualifying race refers to MIN(races.date);

WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverid
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),
first_qualifying_race AS (
    SELECT q.driverid, MIN(r.date) as first_race_date
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    WHERE q.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM youngest_driver)
    GROUP BY q.driverid
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fqr.first_race_date)::int AS year,
    r.name,
    r.date,
    r.time

JOIN youngest_driver yd ON fqr.driverid = yd.driverid
LIMIT 1;

case_reviews.question: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
case_reviews.evidence: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))), COUNT(ID)); male patient refers to sex = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to `T-CHO` > = 250;
case_reviews.generated_sql:

FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id

WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverid
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_qualifying_race AS (
    SELECT q.driverid, MIN(r.date) as first_race_date
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    WHERE q.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM youngest_driver)
    GROUP BY q.driverid
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fqr.first_race_date)::int AS year,
    r.name,
    r.date,
    r.time
FROM first_qualifying_race fqr
JOIN races r ON fqr.first_race_date = r.date
JOIN youngest_driver yd ON fqr.driverid = yd.driverid
LIMIT 1;
